body.prompt: Use the supplied full-screen Failure image only as a visual style/design reference. Create one new independent game resource, never a screenshot crop or screen reconstruction. Match the reference precisely in subdued antique gold, near-black navy lacquer, thin carved details and warm subdued light. Create only the isolated waist-up Ivan character shown in the upper central region of the reference. Match his face, brown tousled curling hair, slight upward gaze to his right, broad chest, dark embroidered midnight-navy tunic, ornate antique-gold pendant and chain, two round cloak clasps and richly embroidered burgundy cloak. He occupies the full lower width with cloak shoulders; include the entire head/hair and both shoulders, cut naturally at lower torso. Somber determined expression. Deep dramatic near-black shadows across clothing, deep muted burgundy rather than bright red. Thin selective warm fire rim along hair and left shoulder, softly lit face, no bright white hair outline, no overall orange wash. High quality painterly Slavic fairy-tale realism. Preserve the recognizable Ivan identity and reference costume. No frame or background. True transparent alpha outside the complete object; preserve fully opaque interior surfaces. No checkerboard, no background scenery, no letters, no numbers, no text, no watermark, no extra items. Leave a small clear margin so all ornament tips are visible.
